name: Haunted Library
rationale: A pointed moonlit window establishes the background, deep wood bookcases and a peeking ghost occupy the midground, and a carved desk, open book, stacked volumes, and brass candelabra form a strong foreground. The staged interior reads immediately as a library and stays distinct from the outdoor Graveyard and Pumpkin Patch Looks. Near-black aubergine surfaces and restrained mint and amber highlights protect academic-page readability.
motionNotes: Three flying pages turn on slow offset arcs. Three candle flames flicker independently while nine dust motes rise through their light. On a long cycle, the friendly ghost eases out from behind the right shelf, looks around, gives a small wave, and retreats. The open book breathes almost imperceptibly. All loops are fixed and bounded for the custom-shader budget.
